panels.title: Топ-10 повільних запитів (середній час виконання, 5 хв)

targets.expr: topk(10, (sum by (queryid, user) (rate(pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{datname="$db",user!="exporter"}[5m])) / sum by (queryid, user) (rate(pg_stat_statements_calls_total{datname="$db",user!="exporter"}[5m]) > 0)) * on (queryid) group_left(query) max by (queryid, query) (pg_stat_statements_query_id))
sum by (queryid, user) (rate(pg_stat_statements_calls_total{datname="$db",user!="exporter"}[5m])) * on (queryid) group_left(query) max by (queryid, query) (pg_stat_statements_query_id)
sum by (queryid, user) (rate(pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{datname="$db",user!="exporter"}[5m])) * on (queryid) group_left(query) max by (queryid, query) (pg_stat_statements_query_id)
